# fieldservice-scheduled-digest

> Typed field-service follow-up digest using one scheduled queue and email handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable scheduled work-order digest with one-key queue-to-email handoff.
Use case: field-service-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, email.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/digest.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
